doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Mabel Mercer and playing the Embers in New York
summary: She saw but never played for Mabel Mercer, found her stuffy, and contrasts New York style with Chicago's energy; she played the Embers.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did you ever meet Mabel Mercer?
Did you ever play for her?
No, I’d go see her with some of my friends. Did you know her?
Oh, did Jo know her too?
Well, that was like New York style. That’s the difference you were talking about between Chicago….
(sings) “It was just one of those things…”
And energy. Where did you play in New York City?
